entities.name: Black mana
entities.description: One of the five colors of mana, drawn from swamps and embodying free will, power and amorality.

entities.name: Blue mana
entities.description: A color allied with black whose quest for omniscience matches black's desire for omnipotence.

entities.name: Red mana
entities.description: A color allied with black that values emotion and freedom.

entities.name: White mana
entities.description: An enemy color of black that values law and the group.

entities.name: Green mana
entities.description: An enemy color of black that values nature and instinct.

relations.quote: it is the ally of blue and red
it is the ally of blue and red

the enemy of white and green

relations.note: Black sees white as legitimizing weakness.
relations.quote: In white, black sees a color that wants to legitimate and perpetuate weakness in the world

relations.note: Black sees green as promoting laziness and conformism.
relations.quote: To black, green is a color that promotes laziness, conformism, and mindlessness
Blue's quest for omniscience matches perfectly with black's desire for omnipotence

relations.note: Both live life on their own terms.
relations.quote: In red, black sees a color willing to live its own life under its terms, overcoming any obstacles in the process
